Stock market news | HDFC Bank shares rise 4% as banking rally

HDFC Bank shares opened strongly at ₹833.10 and climbed to ₹850 by late morning, marking a 4% surge.

The move helped lift NIFTY Bank over 2%, showing a sharp recovery in the banking sector.
